title: Credentialing Committee Standards for Network Participation Agreements: Turnaround, Verification Age, Recredentialing and Liability Limits
content:
These are the credentialing figures for each type of **Network Participation Agreements**: how fast the credentialing committee decides, how old a verification may be, how often a provider is recredentialed, the professional liability limits a provider must carry, and the graces that apply when credentials lapse.

## Figures by agreement type

| Standard | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days from a complete application to the decision | 45 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Maximum age of primary-source verifications at the decision (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Months between credentialing decisions | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |
| Grace after the recredentialing due date (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Minimum liability limit per occurrence (USD) | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 |
| Minimum annual aggregate liability limit (USD) | 1000000 | 3000000 | 3000000 | 3000000 | 3000000 | 3000000 |
| Days after liability expiration to file proof of renewal | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| License suspension, revocation or surrender ends the agreement on the action date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Application fee (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The per-occurrence minimum is 1000000 USD (one million) for every agreement type. The annual aggregate minimum is 1000000 USD under the savings network agreement and 3000000 USD (three million) under every other agreement type.

## Definitions behind the figures

- **Turnaround.** Counted in calendar days from a complete application to the credentialing decision.
- **Verification age.** Each primary-source verification must be no older than the stated number of calendar days on the date of the committee decision.
- **Recredentialing cycle.** The recredentialing due date is the last decision date plus the stated number of months.
- **Recredentialing grace.** During this many calendar days after the recredentialing due date, a recredentialing that is not yet complete does not yet end the agreement.
- **Liability lapse grace.** The practice has this many calendar days after the expiration date of its professional liability policy to file proof of renewal before the agreement is terminated for cause.
- **License action.** Where the table says "Yes", a suspension, revocation or surrender of the license ends the agreement on the date of the action.
- **Application fee.** 0.00 USD means no fee is charged to apply.

## Worked boundary (hypothetical)

Take a hypothetical vision applicant whose policy shows 1000000 USD per occurrence and 2000000 USD aggregate. The per-occurrence limit meets the 1000000 USD minimum. The aggregate falls short of the 3000000 USD minimum for the Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement, so the limits do not meet that agreement's standard. The same limits would meet the 1000000 USD aggregate minimum of the Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement.
